objective: Correct source-table names and policy version metadata identified in reviewer-agent assessment of the B0.2 profile. Preserve the QCG version sequence and conflicting review-date metadata without inferring a resolution.
interface_contract: B0.2 original packet and reviewer-agent findings on a8f3e08294626ec40f78ec8924ed64047b3e740b; Queensland Health Perinatal Statistics 2022 Tables; current Queensland Clinical Guidelines publication/history/PDF sources.
steps: Replace unsupported maternal table numbers with the official summary-table titles; retain exact Table 6 cross-tab identifiers.
Describe the Intrapartum fetal surveillance sequence accurately: V11 was amended 4 September 2026; V12 was recorded 25 September 2026; current linked PDF is V12 and replaces V11.
Record Instrumental vaginal birth PDF identifier MN24.49-V5-R29 and preserve its December 2029 review date alongside the publication index's April 2029 date as unresolved conflicting metadata.
Run packet validation, profile source-integrity assertions and diff checks; obtain a fresh reviewer-agent assessment of the correction commit.

verification.oracle: The review-fix packet binds the verified base and accepted B0.1 dependency.

acceptance: The two selected-variable table labels match the official Queensland PDF wording; method/onset cross-tabs retain their correct numbered tables.
